headline: Hot October CPI pushed the 10-year to about 5% and a December Fed hike is nearly fully priced, with PPI due tomorrow and AI stocks still fragile after the Nov 5 sell-off.
rates: The 10-year Treasury touched about 5.02% after the hot CPI and the 2-year jumped 18bp to about 4.74%.
fed: CME FedWatch shows a December hike nearly fully priced (about 91% for 25bp, roughly 9-13% for 50bp); Waller floated a half-point hike and Logan argued for at least two quarter-point moves.
oil: Brent was around $98 after violent swings (nearly -9% one day, +3.9% the next) with the Iran war keeping crude volatile and sub-$100 crude cited after the midterms.
geo: The Iran war remains a volatile backdrop, and the Democratic midterm wins raised the chance of curbs on AI data-center buildout, which drove the Nov 5 AI sell-off.
